name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana
benefit: ₹5,000 cash benefit for first living child, ₹6,000 for second (if girl child)
benefit_hindi: Pehle bacche par ₹5,000 aur doosri beti par ₹6,000 ki madad

eligibility.description: Pregnant and lactating mothers for first two live births
eligibility.description_hindi: Garbhvati aur stanpaan karaane wali maataon ko pehle do bachche ke liye
criteria: Not receiving similar benefit from any other scheme

steps: Register pregnancy at Anganwadi Centre or health facility
Fill PMMVY application form at Anganwadi Centre
steps_hindi: Anganwadi Centre ya health center mein pregnancy register karaayein
Anganwadi Centre par PMMVY form bharein
Paisa 3 kiston mein bank mein aayega

hindi_summary: PM Matru Vandana Yojana mein garbhvati mahilaon ko pehle bacche par 5000 rupaye aur doosri beti par 6000 rupaye milte hain. Anganwadi Centre mein form bharein. Helpline 181 par call karein.
